name: CJIS Policy Pack
description: DLP controls aligned to the FBI Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Detects Criminal Justice Information (CJI) including CHRI markings, NCIC/III references, law-enforcement-sensitive content, and criminal-justice PII (FBI UCN, ORI, SID, RAP sheet terminology). Policies are delivered in ALLOW/monitor mode — flip to BLOCK after tuning.
